title: Second Attack - Automatic Level 25, All Classes
body:
Syntax: PRAC SECOND ATTACK | PRACTICE SECOND ATTACK

Second Attack automatically unlocks at level 25 for Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu and Bukijutsu. NO SCROLL is needed. A returning level-25+ player who missed the unlock receives it upon login. A legacy Second Attack scroll may still exist at VNUM 31740, but READ no longer consumes or teaches it.

Effect: Your Second Attack skill has a proficiency-based chance of delivering an additional normal melee strike each combat round. It activates automatically in combat, without casting or Chakra cost. Practice it with a teacher after unlocking; subsequent combat use can improve proficiency. Existing mastery is preserved.
